note: Lead-lag test settings. See docs/lead-lag.md. since: start of the study window (covers the 2026 Iran war). quiet_hours: a firing only counts as a new onset after this long without one. big_move: a move of at least this many probability points counts as big.

untested.gps_jamming: No free hourly history. gpsjam.org keeps daily maps, but reading them needs an H3 hex library, which breaks the standard-library rule.

untested.airline_cancellations: The repo has no airline cancellation collector, so there is nothing to test.
